protocol_amendment.reason: The exact-commit V10 red-team review found that five deterministic completed-path provenance and predicate counters were checked only against generous worst-case reservations, so suppression or modest overcharge could remain false-valid. The same review found that the 256 MiB input path retained a block list, joined copy, decoded copy, and parser objects before structural rejection. Follow-up accounting inspection also identified that a predicate reconstruction exception did not mark actual work incomplete.
changes: Accept only the V11 document schema and reject V1-V10 without row verification.

After every row passes semantic curve and factor-base reconstruction, derive exact completed registered prime-candidate, curve-draw, curve-hash, registered-curve point-enumeration, and predicate-hash totals from the verified public transcripts and require equality with observed work.

Freeze the canonical transcript expectations at 480 prime candidates, 112 draws, 336 curve hashes, 218 registered-curve point enumerations, and 4218 predicate hashes; retain zero for all five frozen-fixture expectations.

Add transient factor-base-only controls that exercise all 168 public curve/predicate transcripts without constructing a density row, suppress and overcharge each completed counter by one, and require exact mismatch with actual_work_complete=true.
Mark interrupted factor-base or predicate reconstruction incomplete while preserving work charged before the exception; do not apply completed equality to that path.

Replace the block-list and join snapshot with one exact-size bytearray filled directly through bounded readv slices and incrementally hashed, while retaining final-component no-follow, nonblocking, regular-file, initial-size, exact-length, and before/after identity checks.

Before standard JSON object construction, require ASCII input with no insignificant whitespace and bound lexical tokens, nesting, raw string tokens, and scalar tokens; strictly decode the same buffer, clear it, and only then call the duplicate-key and nonfinite-number rejecting parser.
Keep every generated density-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
The standalone complete five-field semantic oracle remains frozen-B4 only; B6 and B8 secondary objective fields remain deterministic replay confirmations.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: The one-buffer snapshot and lexical preflight bound explicit source-copy and pre-object lexical amplification but are not CPU, wall-time, peak-RSS, parser-object, allocator-retention, disk, I/O, cache-traffic, or memory-bandwidth guarantees.
Canonical B6 and B8 feasibility, serialized output size, cache occupancy, and role resource use remain unmeasured.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, immutable paths, hard process limits, and external resource receipts.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V11 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design with hard external resource containment, not execution.
